Description
South African Gold Coin Krugerrand
is available in several different weights, sizes, and designs. The 1/2 oz South African Gold Coin, also known as the Krugerrand, is probably one of the most desired coins in the world.
Buying a South African Krugerrand Coin can be an exciting investment in your future, especially if you are looking for rare coins that are hard to find. The Krugerrand is known as one of the most highly valued coins in the world because of its historical significance and its status as one of the oldest coins in the world. There have been many speculations and stories about where the name “Krugerrand” came from. One of the most commonly accepted theories is that the coin was used as a standard unit of measurement by Dutch traders during their nine-century mission in South Africa.
The Krugerrand, which is produced by the
South African Mint
, was designed to help boost the South African gold market. The 1/2 oz South African Gold  Coin Krugerrand itself is 22 karat gold (91% pure), with the remaining weight coming from copper. Copper is very durable and gives the Krugerrand an orange tint, similar to crown gold. Krugerrands were developed with private ownership in mind at first, but their effectiveness as money eventually led to the unprecedented. The South African Gold Coin Krugerrand accounted for 90% or more of the global gold coin market by the late 1970s and the first half of 1980. They were serialized and approved for use as legal currency. The event piqued the interest of countries all around the world.
Each of the Gold Coins has been minted 1/2 troy oz of pure gold. Depending on the availability of the coin in our inventory, the year of mintage may change. The 1/2 oz South African Gold Krugerrand Coin doesn’t bear any face engraving on them.
Design of 1/2 oz South African Gold Coin Krugerrand
Since the design of the South African Gold Coin Krugerrand is recognized all over the world, they are easy to liquidate and trade. The artwork of the 1/2 oz South African Krugerrand Gold Coin is an inspiring tribute to both South Africa’s heritage and culture.
On the obverse of the coin, you’ll find a profile of Paul Kruger, a former president of the South African Republic along with the words “SUID AFRIKA” and “SOUTH AFRICA”.
The reverse of the coin depicts a
springbok
, a deer-like animal synonymous with South Africa along with the year of mintage, weight, and purity of the gold coin.

Contains 1/2 oz of 0.9167 fine gold.

Each Gold Krugerrand Coins comes in a protective packaging
